_about: Free play's map (decision 22): every place, open or locked; a locked place says which story opens it (js/core/unlocks.js why()). places[]: id; unlock (the rule id in data/unlocks.json; the place id when missing); modes: what can be played there ({mode, page, errands?}: the page is opened with a play context, js/core/context.js); art: the map picture ids (open and locked; art to make, D1). A tiny example for now: the kitchen and the clinic open, the beach locked until its story. The map's look and the hub that reads it are R3b and R6.
